notes.notes:
Now you can play Storm Tale 2 also using your favorite controller!
Have fun!

notes.title: Support for Apple Silicon computers added!
notes.notes:
The game is now also playable on Apple Silicon computers!

Enjoy it now on your PC, Mac or Linux! 

Have fun!

notes.title: New Languages Supported!
notes.notes: We’re glad to announce that Storm Tale 2 is now available in French, German and Dutch Languages! Enjoy! 😊
